narrator.instruct: Fast-paced, energetic, punchy explainer narrator. Brisk delivery with no long pauses.

trucker.instruct: Dry, amused long-haul truck driver, warm and matter-of-fact, speaking quickly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You've been crawling for twenty minutes. Then the road just opens up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No crash. No roadworks. Nothing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You floor it, sure you've beaten the traffic.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the rest stop, you sip your coffee like a genius.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the trucker from behind you walks in, shaking her head.

lines.speaker: trucker
lines.text: There was no crash, honey. It was just us, braking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sounds crazy, but scientists in Japan tested it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In a twenty oh eight study, they put twenty-two cars on a circular track.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The loop was two hundred thirty metres. No obstacle at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every driver got one rule: cruise at thirty, follow safely.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At first, the circle flowed perfectly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then tiny wobbles appeared in the gaps.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One car slowed a little. The one behind slowed more.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Soon, cars were stopping completely.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A stop-and-go wave was born. Here's the weird part.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The cars drive forward, but the jam crawls backward, about twenty kilometres an hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: New cars join its back as others leave its front.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bottlenecks still cause jams, by packing cars closer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But packed tightly enough, one tap of the brakes is all it takes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Back on the highway, the wave is still rolling backward.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twenty minutes behind you, someone is looking for a crash.
